summary: A fiction excerpt (Book 6, part 62) in which the narrator, after a building implosion nearly killed him, calls his associate Checker while jacking a car. Checker reveals that NSA agents are in his house questioning him about Professor Sonya's case, and he is shaken. The narrator is bitter toward Arthur, who was caught under a collapsing building, and plans to beat the authorities by setting up a meeting with the Lancer, with Checker planting evidence and texting the location.
one_line: The narrator calls Checker after an explosion, learns NSA agents are in Checker's home, and sets a trap for the Lancer to recover Professor Sonya.
key_facts: The narrator was nearly blown up by explosives during the implosion of a building and says he got out in time.
The narrator is jacking another car when he calls Checker.
Checker says there are NSA agents in his house and that his worst nightmare has come to pass.
Checker says the agents are interested in what he knows about Professor Sonya's case, not what he does.
Checker believes it is a joint operation because the NSA doesn't have field agents.
The narrator tells Checker that Arthur had a building fall on him and is fine.
The narrator says Arthur is running to the authorities, including the NSA or Homeland Security.
Checker has planted evidence for the Lancer, mostly, at the time of the call.
The narrator asks Checker to set up a meeting so the Lancer thinks he can track the narrator to a location with no bystanders.
The narrator says he wants to kick the case in the balls and get Professor Sonya back.
Checker sounds dispirited and does not answer whether Arthur is okay after the building incident.
